items.item: 1. 07:686, 'holds in time in two forms, each asking only of later steps'
items.how: ConditionInTime.lean:391-446. UnrestrictedAfter is forall p t g, step p < t -> sig p t g. UnrestrictedEventually is forall p g, exists T, forall t >= T, sig p t g, which is upward closed in T, so it asks only of steps later than the standpoint's. UnrestrictedAfter.eventually (400) gives 'which is stronger'. The two iffs (430, 441) are as the paragraph says. The closing clause, 'which restriction to what comes after is the condition in time ... stay readings', still stands. No quoter.

items.item: 2. 07:571 and 07:982, 'where relations of being affected close, read across all steps'
items.how: The ranking theorem, Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn (PremiseWitnesses.lean:531), takes Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure rel) center) for any rel. Mutual dependence gives the condition along AffectedBy through MutuallyDependent.unrestricted (FlowCenters.lean:141-152), as 07:5 says it ('So read along being affected, it holds where relations close'). This names the relation that Fable's ninth cold reading (section 2.1, and its first hole) says carries the hinge. No quoter in the live tree.

items.item: 6. 07:909, the label '(the continuation condition, a self-concerned order or one meeting C, and the practical commitments; an argument)'

This is 07:5's list ('the continuation condition ..., self-concern, or Comparison'). It replaces an unnamed 'order ranking by widening' that read as an order premise beside the condition. The crosswalk changes are exact copies: four says (482, 25622, 39063, 45717) and the sspiral-human-nature reading. 07:1002's use is a does-not-show item and is exact, so it was rightly kept. No dossier quotes 909 (check_dossiers finds only 354).
It now says 'Where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se', as 07:5 does.

items.verdict: within the cap and better than before; two hypotheses are carried only by the laws (problem 6, low)
items.how: The statement is 300 characters, the cap (style.STATEMENT_CAP), and lints to 0. 'Given one' is the hypothesis some : exists c, L.ReachReturns W c of Flow.returning_downstream_iff_mutuallyDependent (FromTheDynamics.lean:106). It is dropped from the statement, and laws[0] and hypotheses[1] carry it, as the critic proposed. 'And that theorem does not limit other accounts' is exact (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails), and so is 此定理不限. The zh, 在活动、支撑与传承之下, matches laws[4].
